newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED V FENERBAHCE TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED V FENERBAHCE TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup Champions' League Group C match between Manchester United of England and Fenerbahce of Turkey.
Manchester United: 1-Peter Schmeichel, 2-Gary Neville, 3-Denis Irwin, 4-David May, 5-Ronny Johnsen, 7-Eric Cantona, 8-Nicky Butt, 10-David Beckham, 14-Jordi Cruyff, 15-Karel Poborsky, 16-Roy Keane.

Fenerbahce: 1-Rustu Recber, 2-Ilker Yagcioglu, 3-Uche Okechukwu, 4-Jes Hogh, 5-Kemalettin Senturk, 8-Tuncay Agcun, 9-Elvir Bolic, 10-Augustine "Jay Jay" Okocha, 11-Emil Kostadinov, 14-Saffet Akbas, 15-Erol Bulut.
